item.title: Netanyahu to meet Trump in a first encounter since the Iran war began
item.description: The meeting occurs as both leaders face domestic pressures. Netanyahu is up for reelection, partly embattled by his strained ties with Trump.

item.title: AI tokens could become the kilowatt-hour of the AI age
item.description: AI companies use tokens to track usage and bill customers. Economists now use them to measure AI's spread through the economy.

item.title: Saving money while paying off credit card debt is achievable. Here's how
item.description: Experts advise saving alongside debt repayment to avoid a cycle of borrowing. Learn how to allocate funds in your budget.

item.title: Trump broke ethics norms. Will voters trust Democrats to restore them?
item.description: Democrats argue now is the time for anti-corruption reforms to check Donald Trump and overhaul the system.
